title: The project declares its workflow shape in a stable in-repo file the materialiser reads
asA: operator standing up an rcf-lite project with the delivery-ci-workflows blueprint applied
iWant: to declare my project's CI workflow shape once in a stable in-repo configuration file that the workflow-materialiser reads on every run
soThat: the workflow set my project produces is a function of a checked-in declaration, not a hidden default or an operator's memory

acceptanceCriteria.description: The workflow-materialiser reads its input `workflowShape` from the stable path `.rcf/config/delivery-ci-workflows.json` on the project tree. The reader path is documented in the blueprint guide and does not vary with CI provider. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project that has applied delivery-ci-workflows v2 and populated `.rcf/config/delivery-ci-workflows.json`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the workflow-materialiser runs (locally or in CI)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the materialiser reads the file at the documented path and treats its `workflowShape` as authoritative

acceptanceCriteria.description: The three required fields (`branchModel`, `checkSet`, `providerHint`), the optional `releaseMode` field (absent has the same effect as `releaseMode: none`, per Q6-B ratification), the optional `scheduledAudit` field, the optional `trunkPullRequests` sub-field, and the optional substitution-surface fields `defaultBranch` (default `main`), `trunkBranch` (default `main`), and `packageManager` (default `pnpm`; recognised set `pnpm`, `npm`, `yarn`, `bun`) are the complete surface the workflow-materialiser reads. No other field the file carries is interpreted at this version; unknown fields are ignored (forward-compatibility). Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `workflowShape` declaration carrying the three required fields, the optional fields, and additional unknown fields
acceptanceCriteria.then: the materialiser processes the recognised fields (including the substitution-surface trio) and ignores the unknown fields without failing the boot-check

acceptanceCriteria.description: A workflowShape configuration whose branchModel is `trunk` but whose materialised outputs still write a pull-request-checks workflow (drift from ADR-706 defaults) fails a materialiser self-check: the writer refuses with WORKFLOW_SHAPE_MISMATCH naming branchModel and the extra file. Prevents silent divergence from the ratified shape mapping. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the elicited workflowShape.branchModel; the AC substitutes the project's branch model for the illustrative trunk and the writer-refused file for pull-request-checks.yml.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a materialiser invoked with branchModel=trunk and a stub that would still emit pull-request-checks.yml
acceptanceCriteria.then: the writer refuses with WORKFLOW_SHAPE_MISMATCH naming branchModel=trunk and the pull-request-checks.yml file; nothing is written
